pathway.title: Churchill Downs Inc — Full credit assessment
pathway.question: Should we own this issuer, in which instrument, and why?

runs.text: Leverage has improved but not yet durably. Net debt over EBITDA fell from 4.64x at year-end 2025 to 3.94x at 2026-09-30 and from 4.09x to 3.66x on Adjusted EBITDA, with higher earnings and repayment contributing about equally, while the new buyback authority and the implied October repurchases show how the 3.94x can become 4.00x within weeks; the quarterly report's own net debt line is not net of cash, so this view uses net debt after cash. Basis: Financial foundation (CP-1); Business & governance (CP-1A); calculation C1; calculation C2

Cash generation is the core strength. Free cash flow after capital expenditure, cash interest and cash tax was USD 529.9 million over the last twelve months, 42.55% of Adjusted EBITDA, while capital expenditure took 18.14% of Adjusted EBITDA and EBITDA covered cash interest 4.22x, so the business can repay debt from internal cash if shareholder returns stay restrained. Basis: Financial foundation (CP-1); calculation C3

Liquidity is adequate and the revolver and term loan A run to September 2031. Cash of USD 167 million and undrawn revolver of USD 511 million pro forma for the redemption give USD 678 million against identified near-term cash calls of USD 88.15 million to USD 108.15 million, and scheduled amortization is only USD 60 million a year until the USD 700 million 2028 notes mature in January 2028. Basis: Financial foundation (CP-1); 10-Q_2026-09-30_chdn-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 14; 10-Q_2026-09-30_chdn-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 16; calculation C6; calculation C7

The 2028 notes make 2027 the key financing window. The revolver and term loan A carry a springing maturity if earlier notes are not refinanced at least 91 days ahead, which would be about 2027-10-16 for the 2028 notes if the test covers them; the credit agreement is not supplied, so coverage is not established, and the redemption of the 2027 notes with revolver borrowings means the revolver now carries USD 679 million. Basis: Financial foundation (CP-1); 10-Q_2026-09-30_chdn-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 14; 10-Q_2026-09-30_chdn-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 16; 10-Q_2026-09-30_chdn-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 28; calculation C8

Machine revenue is the primary downside. Historical racing machines supply 33.35% of nine-month revenue and Live and Historical Racing supplies 49.39% of segment Adjusted EBITDA, all in two states, and a Louisiana court ruling already ended the company's machines there; each USD 100 million fall in EBITDA lifts net leverage from 3.94x to 4.31x, so a state-level shock would move leverage well above the current level before management levers apply. Basis: Business & governance (CP-1A); Financial foundation (CP-1); 10-K_2025-12-31_chdn-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 18; 10-K_2025-12-31_chdn-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 19; calculation C4; calculation C9

Earnings are seasonal and partly not controlled cash. The Derby quarter produced 47.80% of nine-month Adjusted EBITDA and 38.30% of the last twelve months, and equity-investee earnings are 15.02% of Adjusted EBITDA with 92.17% cash conversion, so Adjusted EBITDA overstates controlled cash and quarter-end debt readings need last-twelve-months earnings. Basis: Business & governance (CP-1A); Financial foundation (CP-1); EX-99.1_2026-07-29_ex991pressrelease07-29x26.htm.jsonl, page 1; calculation C9; calculation C11

Financial policy is the main swing factor and the governance risk is Medium. Shareholder returns were 92.67% of free cash flow in FY2025 and 15.50% in nine months 2026, no sponsor is identified so there is no equity backstop, and reporting is audited and quarterly, while the proxy statement and the debt documents are not supplied, so control and legal capacity are not established. Basis: Business & governance (CP-1A); Source readiness (CP-0); calculation C9

The perimeter and the debt stack are shifting. The company is exploring a sale of nine properties with USD 280 million to USD 300 million of annual Adjusted EBITDA, which would lift net leverage on Adjusted EBITDA from 3.66x to between 4.72x and 4.82x unless proceeds of at least USD 1,024.80 million to USD 1,098.00 million repay debt, and the secured share of principal rises from 34.71% to 47.35% after the redemption, so the remaining notes sit behind more secured debt although legal rank is not stated. Basis: Business & governance (CP-1A); Financial foundation (CP-1); calculation C5; calculation C9

Interest-rate exposure rose with the redemption. The company reports that a one percentage point rise in SOFR would cut net income and operating cash flow by USD 12 million on USD 1.6 billion of variable-rate debt, and moving USD 600 million of fixed-rate notes into the revolver lifts that to about USD 16.37 million. Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_chdn-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 49; 10-Q_2026-09-30_chdn-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 13; calculation C10

runs.text: Strength: the cash engine. Free cash flow after capital expenditure, cash interest and cash tax of USD 529.9 million over the last twelve months covers 11.22% of debt and EBITDA covers cash interest 4.22x, so internal cash can repay debt when buybacks pause, and the pause in 2026 repaid the revolver by USD 578 million. Basis: Financial foundation (CP-1); calculation C3; calculation C13

Strength: scale and diversification around a marquee asset. Revenue of USD 3,004.9 million over the last twelve months comes from racing, wagering and ten wholly owned casinos plus two affiliates, with Adjusted EBITDA margin of 41.44%, so a shock to one profit pool other than machines would not overwhelm debt service. Basis: Financial foundation (CP-1); Business & governance (CP-1A); calculation C9; calculation C11

Strength: liquidity and extended maturities. The revolver and term loan A run to September 2031 and a term loan B to 2033, scheduled amortization is USD 60 million a year, and pro forma liquidity is USD 678 million. Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_chdn-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 14; 10-Q_2026-09-30_chdn-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 15; calculation C6; calculation C7
Strength: reporting quality. Audited statements, an effective control report and quarterly releases give creditors reliable and frequent data. Basis: Business & governance (CP-1A)

Weakness: legal concentration of machine revenue. A third of revenue and about half of segment earnings depend on machine laws and taxes in Kentucky and Virginia, and the Louisiana ruling shows an adverse outcome is possible, which would raise leverage by 0.37x for each USD 100 million of lost EBITDA. Basis: Business & governance (CP-1A); calculation C4; calculation C9

Weakness: discretionary shareholder returns. Returns reached 92.67% of free cash flow in FY2025 and a new USD 750 million authority exists, so the deleveraging of 2026 can reverse within a quarter, as the implied October repurchases show. Basis: Business & governance (CP-1A); calculation C9; calculation C2

Weakness: perimeter and structure uncertainty. A sale of nine properties with USD 280 million to USD 300 million of Adjusted EBITDA, a rising secured share of debt and unnamed guarantors leave the creditor position undefined until terms and documents are disclosed. Basis: Business & governance (CP-1A); calculation C5

blocks.title: Transaction summary and new debt issues

runs.text: The company issued no new notes in 2026 and entered one new debt instrument, a USD 500 million term loan B due 2033 issued at 99.875% of principal at 175 bp over SOFR on 2026-09-25, alongside an eighth amendment that extended the revolver and term loan A to September 2031 with a springing maturity. The proceeds repaid the term loan B-1 and revolver borrowings, so the transaction extended maturities rather than adding debt, and the secured share of principal then rose when the USD 600 million 2027 notes were redeemed with revolver borrowings on 2026-10-19. Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_chdn-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 13; 10-Q_2026-09-30_chdn-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 14; 10-Q_2026-09-30_chdn-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 15; 10-Q_2026-09-30_chdn-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 16; 10-Q_2026-09-30_chdn-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 28; calculation C6

Other transactions that matter to creditors are the August 2025 purchase of 90% of Casino Salem for a base price of USD 180.0 million funded with revolver borrowings, the August 2026 re-acquisition of the 49% of United Tote held by the New York Racing Association together with a tote services extension to 2035, and the announced exploration of a sale of nine wholly owned regional gaming properties. The re-acquisition removed a put right and a redeemable noncontrolling interest, while the sale exploration has no stated terms. Basis: 10-K_2025-12-31_chdn-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 66; 10-K_2025-12-31_chdn-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 94; 10-Q_2026-09-30_chdn-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 21; 10-Q_2026-09-30_chdn-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 32; EX-99.1_2026-10-28_ex991pressrelease10-28x26.htm.jsonl, page 3; calculation C9; calculation C13

Adjusted EBITDA includes the company's share of equity-investee EBITDA and the portion attributable to noncontrolling interests, and segment revenue is stated before intercompany eliminations, so Q3 2026 revenue of USD 714 million across the three segments reconciles to consolidated net revenue of USD 696 million only after All Other revenue of USD 2 million and USD 20 million of eliminations. The releases also quote net bank leverage of 3.8x, 3.7x and 3.8x for Q1, Q2 and Q3 2026 with no definition or calculation printed.

fields.value: On 2026-07-29 the company announced that it is exploring a sale of nine wholly owned regional gaming properties, which it says represent USD 280 million to USD 300 million of annual Adjusted EBITDA including retail sportsbook and market access. The only statement of this in the set is one sentence in the Q3 2026 quarterly report, and the earlier Q2 documents mention strategic alternatives only in their risk language, so the announcement, the property list, any buyer, price, timetable or use of proceeds are not established. Until they are, the perimeter that Business & governance and Fundamental credit describe stays open.

fields.value: The debt documents, the proxy statement and any rating or market price are the main absent sources. The annual report lists the indentures, supplemental indentures and credit agreement among its exhibits but they are not supplied, and directors, ownership and compensation are incorporated by reference to a proxy statement that is also absent. Debt terms therefore rest on the filings' own summaries, and legal and covenant analysis cannot be completed from this set.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The strongest case against calling the set ready is that the terms creditors rely on most sit in executed documents that are missing: the springing maturity, the guarantor list and the covenant definitions are known only from summaries, and the 2026 reports print no covenant test. Against that, the summaries agree with each other and with the balance sheets, every total tied in the checks, and the company states compliance at year-end, so the figures look reliable and only the legal reading is open. Supplying the eighth amendment to the credit agreement, the indentures and the 2026-07-29 announcement would let the legal and perimeter questions be answered, and a later filing that restates 2026 figures or confirms a sale agreement would require the analyses to be rerun.

fields.value: Churchill Downs Inc (issuer id chdn), as of 2026-11-05, credit snapshot pathway. This answer sets out the business, ownership, governance, capital allocation and transaction facts that matter to creditors and the governance risk they support.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Churchill Downs is a company with no sponsor identified, so creditors depend on board capital-allocation choices, while a seasonal Derby profit pool, legally contingent machine revenue and a possible sale of nine gaming properties make the earnings base less certain than leverage suggests.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The second quarter, which holds Kentucky Derby week, produced 47.80% of nine-month Adjusted EBITDA, historical racing machines in Kentucky and Virginia supplied 33.35% of nine-month revenue, and the company says nine properties carrying USD 280 million to USD 300 million of annual Adjusted EBITDA are under review for sale. Governance risk is Medium because shareholder returns, which reached 92.67% of free cash flow in FY2025, can reverse the 2026 deleveraging, and the evidence on control and legal capacity is incomplete.

fields.value: Machine revenue is legally contingent and sits in two states. Historical racing machines produced 33.35% of nine-month revenue, with 52.55% of the machines in Kentucky and 47.45% in Virginia, and the Louisiana Supreme Court's ruling ended the company's machines in Louisiana on 2025-05-08 and sent them mainly to Virginia. In Q3 2026 Central Virginia earnings fell by USD 10 million, including USD 5 million of new tax under a structure effective 2026-07-01 and the effect of competition, so the redeployed capacity is facing a tougher market while one adverse ruling or tax change in either state would cut revenue directly.

fields.value: Capital returns have been large and discretionary. Repurchases and dividends equalled 92.67% of free cash flow after capital expenditure in FY2025, when the revolver grew while the company bought back stock and acquired Casino Salem for USD 180.0 million, then fell to 15.50% in nine months 2026 as the revolver was repaid. A new repurchase authority of up to USD 750 million was approved on 2026-10-27 and the fall in remaining authority from USD 382 million to USD 306 million implies USD 76 million of October repurchases, which would add to net debt after the redemption, so deleveraging can reverse by board decision.

Creditors gain only if proceeds repay debt at a multiple at least equal to the leverage left behind, so the perimeter stays open until terms are disclosed.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The October 2026 redemption of the USD 600 million 2027 notes with revolver borrowings lifts the secured share of principal from 34.71% to 47.35%. The credit agreement is collateralized by substantially all wholly owned assets and the remaining notes are described as unsecured, so the 2028, 2030 and 2031 notes sit behind more secured debt, although no source states legal rank.

fields.value: Reporting quality is a genuine strength. The financial statements and internal control over financial reporting were audited by PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP, management concluded that internal control was effective at 2025-12-31, and results are released quarterly, although covenant ratios and a compliance statement appear only in the annual report and a new financial reporting system was introduced in 2026.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Large builds absorb cash before they earn. The company plans a first-turn building of USD 280 million to USD 300 million at Churchill Downs Racetrack due by the 2028 Derby and Rockingham Grand Casino of USD 180 million to USD 200 million opening in mid-2027, while 2026 project capital was cut by USD 30 million at the midpoint to a plan of USD 160 million to USD 180 million, so the programme competes with debt repayment and buybacks for free cash flow through 2028.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The best evidence for lower governance risk is the record: audited reporting, an effective control report, no documented extraction, cure request or liability management, a dividend that has risen for sixteen consecutive years at a small cash cost, and buybacks that paused while the revolver fell by USD 578 million in 2026. The supplied legal proceedings disclosure describes only ordinary routine litigation, with no pending ruling against machines in Kentucky or Virginia. A proxy statement showing a controlling holder or related-party arrangements, or buybacks resuming with revolver funding, would raise the risk level, while sale proceeds applied to debt and a defined perimeter would lower it.

fields.value: Churchill Downs Inc (issuer id chdn), as of 2026-11-05, credit snapshot pathway. This answer synthesises the source readiness, financial foundation and business and governance work into a fundamental credit view, with the main strength, the primary downside path and the monitoring triggers.

Free cash flow after capital expenditure of USD 529.9 million is 11.22% of debt, interest cover is 4.22x and liquidity is USD 678 million pro forma, so near-term liquidity risk is low. The primary downside path is a ruling or tax change on machines, which supply 49.39% of segment earnings, landing on a balance sheet with committed projects and a USD 750 million buyback authority.

fields.value: Competitive rivalry is high: racetracks compete for horses and for simulcast wagering dollars, casinos compete with other gaming and sports betting for discretionary spend, and more states legalising gaming increases supply, which pressures margins and share; this links to lower EBITDA and higher leverage. The threat of new entrants comes from new state authorisations and licences rather than capital, which matters because new gaming near the company's venues could take revenue. Substitutes such as sports wagering and other entertainment compete for the same spend, buyers are individual customers whose discretionary spend can shift, and suppliers matter in two places: horsemen's groups negotiated annually and machine manufacturers that could limit popular games or require participation leases, which can raise costs or reduce machine yield.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Political and regulatory factors are a primary credit driver: gaming licences, machine statutes, gaming taxes and sports wagering taxes set the profit pool, and the Louisiana ruling and the Virginia tax structure effective 2026-07-01 are direct evidence. Economic factors matter through consumer confidence and discretionary spending, which the annual report names as a market risk, and interest rates matter through USD 1.6 billion of variable-rate debt. Social and technological factors do not appear to be primary credit drivers based on the provided materials.

Weaknesses are machine legal concentration, discretionary buybacks, the 2028 notes and springing maturity, and an Adjusted EBITDA that includes affiliate earnings. Opportunities that could improve credit quality are the use of any sale proceeds to repay debt, Rockingham Grand Casino opening in mid-2027, and further revolver repayment. Threats are an adverse ruling or tax change on machines, resumed buybacks funded by the revolver and a failed refinancing of the 2028 notes.

Liquidity of USD 678 million pro forma and scheduled amortization of USD 60 million a year mean liquidity distress is unlikely within 12 months, but leverage of about 4.3x would complicate the 2027 refinancing of the 2028 notes ahead of the springing maturity, so management levers are the pause in buybacks, the cut in project capital and asset sales, and the observable triggers are the machine revenue share, the Adjusted EBITDA margin and the revolver draw.
